facts.why: After Ehud came Shamgar son of Anath.
When Gideon was dead, the leaders of Shechem made his son Abimelech their king.
After the time of Abimelech, Tola rose up to save Israel.
After the death of Saul, the men of Judah anointed David king at Hebron.
Jeroboam fled to Shishak king of Egypt and stayed there until Solomon died, so Shishak already reigned before Jeroboam became king.
Shishak was already king of Egypt while Solomon lived, before Solomon's son Rehoboam reigned.
Zimri struck down the king and reigned; when the army heard it, they proclaimed Omri king that very day.
When Athaliah saw that her son Ahaziah was dead, she seized the throne.
Shallum struck Zechariah down and reigned in his place.
Menahem struck Shallum down and reigned in his place.
Pharaoh Neco made Eliakim king, renamed him Jehoiakim, and carried Jehoahaz off to Egypt.
The king of Babylon made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin's uncle, king in his place and renamed him Zedekiah.
Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt killed Josiah at Megiddo, and then the people made Jehoahaz king.
Pharaoh Neco made Eliakim son of Josiah king and renamed him Jehoiakim.
Abijam became king of Judah in the eighteenth year of Jeroboam's reign.
Asa became king of Judah in the twentieth year of Jeroboam's reign.
Nadab became king of Israel in the second year of Asa's reign.
Baasha became king of all Israel in the third year of Asa's reign.
Elah became king of Israel in the twenty-sixth year of Asa's reign.
Zimri reigned in Tirzah in the twenty-seventh year of Asa's reign.
Omri became king of Israel in the thirty-first year of Asa's reign.
Ahab became king of Israel in the thirty-eighth year of Asa's reign.
Ahaziah son of Ahab became king of Israel in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat's reign.
Jehoram son of Ahab became king of Israel in the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat's reign.
Ahaziah son of Jehoram became king of Judah in the twelfth year of Joram of Israel.
Joash became king of Judah in the seventh year of Jehu.
Jehoahaz son of Jehu became king of Israel in the twenty-third year of Joash of Judah.
Jehoash son of Jehoahaz became king of Israel in the thirty-seventh year of Joash of Judah.
Amaziah became king of Judah in the second year of Jehoash of Israel.
Jeroboam son of Jehoash became king of Israel in the fifteenth year of Amaziah.
Azariah (Uzziah) became king of Judah in the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam II.
Zechariah son of Jeroboam became king of Israel in the thirty-eighth year of Azariah (Uzziah).
Shallum became king in the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah.
Menahem became king of Israel in the thirty-ninth year of Azariah (Uzziah).
Pekahiah became king of Israel in the fiftieth year of Azariah (Uzziah).
Pekah became king of Israel in the fifty-second year of Azariah (Uzziah).
Ahaz became king of Judah in the seventeenth year of Pekah.
Hoshea became king of Israel in the twelfth year of Ahaz.
Hezekiah became king of Judah in the third year of Hoshea.
